purpose: The detector the repair path serves, frozen on the deployment's own healthy population. Separate from and additive to results/framework_monitor_freeze.json, which is the immutable pre-fix baseline and is not touched.

pre_onset_alarms.note: Injected episodes whose first alarm precedes onset. Counted as misses in detection, reported here so the mechanism is visible.

e+m.runway_note: Misses at runway <= 2 are runway-limited: the episode ended before enough post-onset evidence existed. They are counted as misses, and reported separately so they are not read as detector accuracy.

pre_onset_alarms.note: Injected episodes whose first alarm precedes onset. Counted as misses in detection, reported here so the mechanism is visible.

e+m+c.runway_note: Misses at runway <= 2 are runway-limited: the episode ended before enough post-onset evidence existed. They are counted as misses, and reported separately so they are not read as detector accuracy.
